segments.text: Good afternoon. This is Aakashwani and I am Anubhav Rahatki with the Midday News.
The headlines
Supreme Court directs center to set up comprehensive national database for removal of child sexual
exploitation and abuse material from internet. Center seeks reports from Punjab government
over killings of activists campaigning against sale and abuse of narcotic drugs.
U.S. President Donald Trump waives tariffs and specified provisions under Sanction in
Russia and Iran Act, providing relief to major Russian oil importers.
IMD forecasts heavy to very heavy rainfall over South Interior, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu
and Puducherry today.
An immense cricket, India to face western days in fifth and final T20 match in Bangaluru
this evening.
The Supreme Court has called for stronger technological and regulatory measures to detect and remove
child sexual exploitation and abuse material from the internet.
A bench of justices J. B. Parthivala and K. V. Chandran directed the creation of a comprehensive
national database to identify and remove such content across social media platforms.
The court expressed concern over the continued circulation of this material,
despite its 2024 directions.
Highlighting that technological safeguards alone are insufficient, the bench emphasized
the need to equip children with awareness and safe internet practices.
It called for digital safety and age-appropriate education to be included in the core curriculum.
The Union Government has been directed through the Ministry of Electronics and Information
technology and the Ministry of Law and Justice to frame necessary guidelines, standard operating
procedures and IT rules amendments. The government must file an affidavit detailing its implementation
progress by the next hearing on December 10th, 2026. The Supreme Court has declared that the
right to access and use of the internet is a fundamental right guaranteed to every individual,
including children under Articles 21 and 19.1a of the Constitution.
A bench of Justice J.B. Parthivala and Justice K. Vinod Chandran observed that children,
irrespective of their age, enjoy these constitutional protections.
Reversing earlier judicial hesitation on whether Internet access itself is a fundamental right,
the APIC Scott affirmed that protecting children from the online harms
cannot be a ground to deny them digital access altogether.
The Ministry of Home Affairs MHA has written letters to the Punjab government seeking detailed
reports on two killings and the suicide of a man amid allegations linked to narcotics
and concerns over their potential law and order implications in the state. Sources said
that the ministry has written three separate letters to the state government in this regard.
We have more from our correspondent.
The Home Ministry has sought factual and detailed report from the Punjab government on the recent
murder of the anti-drugs crusader Parvinder Singh Chhota by a chemist in Mansa district.
Reports have also been asked for in the incidents of attack on three individuals allegedly linked
to their objections to sale of narcotics in a village of Borodistic Gurdaspur and
suicide of the father of a youth struggling with substance dependence in Senghru district.
It is alleged that the person was subjected to systematic harassment and pressured by the
local village panchayat which drove him to take his own life.
The ministry has asked Punjab government to share a detailed report in view of the potential
law and order implications in the border state.
At the same time, the Ministry of Home Affairs also sought an update on the action taken
by the Punjab government on the Union Home Minister's vision document on narcotics
control 2026-2029 which was shared with the Chief Minister Bhagwan Singh Mahan on August 10th this
year. Rajesh Bali, Akashwani News, Jalandhar. The election commission has said that draft electoral
rolls under the special summary revision SSR will be published on the 12th of November
this year while the final rolls will be published on the 4th of January next year. In a statement,
the commission said that eligible citizens can file objections and claims from the 12th
of the next month till 11th December. It's said that young citizens turning 18 on 1st
April 2027, 1st July 2027 or 1st October 2027 can apply in advance for enrolment. Help desks
will be set up at district level to facilitate enrolment of electors, especially migrants
vulnerable and marginalised. Earlier the commission had ordered a special summary revision
of electoral roles in 14 states and 3 union territories, with a 1st of January next year
as the qualifying date.
The Centre has made adhar authentication or proof of possession of an adhar number necessary
to avail of scholarship benefits under the PM Cares for Children Scheme.
The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment has issued a notification in this regard.
It set the beneficiaries of the special scholarship scheme under PM Cares for Children,
which provides assistance for continuing education from Class 1 to 12 will be required to undergo
Aadhaar authentication or furnish proof of possession of an Aadhaar number. The notification
stated that no child will be denied assistance for failure to authenticate Aadhaar or for
not having been assigned an Aadhaar number. The government has issued a clarification
after certain sections of the media brought out reports questioning the legislative
developments in the year 2003, concerning its shareholding in IDBI. The Finance Ministry today
said that an amendment seeking to restrict the dilution of government's stake in IDBI was rejected
and did not form part of the enacted legislation during the discussions on the Union budget 2003
and the parliamentary debate on the IDBI repeal act 2003. The ministry said that the matter
was subsequently examined by the Delhi High Court.
Senior BJP leader LK Advani has been admitted to Apollo hospitals with a chest infection.
In a statement, Apollo hospital said that Mr. Advani is currently in the ICU under the
care of senior consultant of neurology Dr. Vinit Suri.
It said that Mr. Advani's condition is stable and he remains under close medical supervision.
A Delhi court today issued bailable warrants against YouTuber Dhruv Rathi in a 2018 defamation
case. The case was filed by a BJP IT cell member. Judicial magistrate Rahul Jain issued the warrants
in the case of defamation over a video uploaded on Rathi's YouTube channel. The court has listed
the matter for further proceedings on October 31st. This is Akashwani giving you the news.
Donald Trump has waived tariffs and several sanctions provisions under the Sanctioning
Russia and Iran Act of 2026, providing relief to India and China from the specified tariff
measures targeting major purchasers of Russian oil and gas.
In an order, President Trump cited the national interest of the United States for the decision.
The move came a day before the deadline for implementing the tariff provisions of
the legislation, which he signed on September 18.
The law provided for additional duties of up to 100% on goods imported into the United
States from the five largest purchasers of Russian origin crude oil and natural gas.
The waivers will remain in effect until the President or the Secretary of State, in consultation
with relevant officials, determines that further action is appropriate.
The development comes ahead of the US Secretary of State Marco Rubio's scheduled visit
to India.
He is expected to hold talks with external affairs minister Dr. S. J. Shankar in Mumbai
on October 20th and visit the Jamnagar Refinery complex in Gujarat.
The move comes amid a reported diesel supply deal between Russia and the United States
as diesel prices rise in the US ahead of the November midterm elections.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined
by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by
this vision for Seva and Sushasana, the government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving
the goal of a Vixit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment,
this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series Seva Sankalb Abhyan,
we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated
integrated into action through pathbreaking initiatives such as the PM Gatishakti National
Master Plan.
Launched in 2021, PM Gatishakti introduced a revolutionary philosophy to infrastructure
building not in isolated silos but as one connected national network. Its GI-based
national master plan integrates data from 16 key ministries and departments enabling
planners to identify gaps and seamlessly coordinate projects before construction
begins. Today this platform maps infrastructure projects worth over 100 lakh crore rupees aligning
highways, railways, ports, airports and power lines into one unified system. This integrated approach
has helped bring India's logistic cost down from around 13-14% of GDP to nearly 8% boosting the
global competitiveness of Indian products. Highlighting the transformative power of the
integrated planning approach, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said by uniting disconnected
connected projects into a single high-speed growth engine, PM Gati Shakti continues to
pave the way for modern, efficient and vixit Bharat.
Aparna Khunt, Aakashwani News, Ahmedabad.
Eight devotees were killed and 15 others injured after a tempo-traveller plunged into a rainwater
drain on the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway in Radhistan's Kota district this morning.
The accident occurred near the Karadia-Tol Plaza in the Simalya Police Station area.
The vehicle carrying devotees from Madhya Pradesh to Khatushamji Temple reportedly went out
of control and fell around 20 feet from a bridge into the drain.
In Gujarat five workers were killed and five others injured following a powerful reactor
explosion and subsequent toxic gas leak at a chemical manufacturing factory in Bharuch
district.
The incident occurred late last night during a hydrogenation process.
The blast also caused the leak of methylene dichloride gas.
The injured workers were immediately rushed to a nearby hospital for emergency treatment.
Durga Puja festivities are being observed in Odisha with devotion and festive fervour,
with Mahasashti being observed today.
Coinciding with Navratri, the festival celebrates the divine feminine power and the triumph of good over evil.
Navratri honors Goddess Durga in her various forms over nine nights,
commemorating her victory over the demon Mahishasura.
In Odisha, the main Durga Puja rituals began this morning at different puja pundals with
mahasasti.
When the Goddess was ceremonially welcomed, mahasattami, mahasattami and mahanabami are
marked by special prayers and religious observances, culminating in Bijaya Dasami,
which symbolizes the victory of righteousness.
All cities and towns in Odisha, including Bhuvaneswar and Katak, are witnessing festive
celebrations with elaborately decorated bundles and artistic displays.
Katak is renowned for its exquisite silver fill-grit decorations known as Chandi-Medha
while Purish-traditional Gosani-jatra adds a distinctive cultural dimension.
Prakash Das, Akashwani News, Bhuvaneshwar.
veteran film music composer and director Devanesan Chokalingam also called Deva passed away in Chennai
today. He was 75. Known as Tenisai Tendral, he was one of the prominent composers in Tamil cinema
and was well known for his folk-based tunes. The India Meteorological Department has issued an
orange colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaykal
till tomorrow. Heavy rainfall is also expected over Karnataka, Kerala and Mahe during the next two
days. In cricket, India's men team will face the western D's in the decisive fifth and final
T20 international at M. Churnaswamy Stadium, Bangaluru this evening. The game is scheduled to
begin at 7 p.m. Indian Standard Time. The Five Math series is level at two all.
And now, before we end the bulletin, the headlines once again.
Supreme Court directs Center to set up comprehensive national database for removal of child sexual
exploitation and abuse material from internet. Center seeks reports from Punjab government
over killings of activists campaigning against sale and abuse of narcotic drugs.
U.S. President Donald Trump waives tariffs and specified provisions under Sanction in
Russia and Iran Act, providing relief to major Russian oil importers.
IMD forecasts heavy to very heavy rainfall over South Indira, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and
Puducherry today, and in men's cricket India to face West Indies in the fifth and final
T-20 match in Bengaluru this evening.
And with that, we end the mid-tenues.
